contract: Store.transaction promises atomic writes with vectors rolled back alongside rows.
observed: Six deterministic controls: both file-deferred conditions preserve SQL rows but change previously committed vector/search state after a later transaction abort. Explicit-flush and in-memory controls preserve all observed state. In the delete case the previously deleted vector returns through the public storage vector/search interface; in the insert case a previously committed new vector disappears. File-backed mismatch is also observed after close/reopen.
mechanism: File-backed transaction exception handling reloads the last saved vector snapshot rather than the vector state at transaction entry. Periodic saving leaves an interval where SQL commits are newer than that snapshot.
